title: Kaimbulawa language - Wikipedia
text: Kaimbulawa is an Austronesian language spoken on the island of Siompu, southwest of Buton Island, which is off the southeast coast of Sulawesi in Indonesia. It belongs to the Muna-Buton branch of the Celebic subgroup.

title: Kaimbulawa language — Grokipedia
text: Kaimbulawa is an Austronesian language of the Malayo-Polynesian branch, spoken by approximately 1,000 people (as of 2023) primarily in Southeast Sulawesi Province, Indonesia, in villages including Kaimbulawa, Lantoi, Waidawula, Lontoy, Karae, and Kambe-Kambero on Siompu Island (southwest of Buton Island).
